PART III – LANDSPART III – LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Order under Section 39 (a) (1)

THE allotment speciﬁed in the Order No. 317 of 2012 made under the Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460) and published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1789/30 dated 19th December 2012 are vested absolutely in the State and the possession of which has been taken for or on behalf of the State under Paragraph (a) of Section 40 of the aforesaid Act. But by the virtue of powers vested in me by Sub section (1) of Section 39 (a) (inserted by Act, No. 8 of 1979) of the Land Acquisition Act, I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation, do hereby divest only the allotment speciﬁed in the Schedule below:
K. D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation.

My No.: 4-3/10/2012/LRB/13. Land Acquiring Ofﬁcer’s No.:- WGSWD & EIP/ACQ/KB/01.Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”,Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla,20th May, 2025.
SCHEDULE

An allotment of land depicted in below name and extent in the Preliminary Plan No. ෙකා 9481 dated 13.10.2016, prepared by the Surveyor-General, situated in the Villagescalled Boralesgamuwa, Diwulapitiya in Boralesgamuwa and Diwulapitiya Grama Niladhari Divisions in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kesbewa in Colombo District of Western Province and bounded as follows:

01. Lot No. 03 – Land bearing No. 318/3 (a portion) on Old Kesbewa Road – Extent: 0.0027 Hectare North: Lot Nos. 1, 2 and Lands bearing Nos. 318/3, 79/39, 60 B on Old Kesbewa Road; East: Lands bearing Nos. 79/39, 60 B on Old Kesbewa Road; South: Land bearing No. 38/7 and Lot No. 4; West: Lot No. 4.
